business_summary.text: Cipla reported Q2FY27 results with a 2% YoY decline in revenue to ₹7,404 Cr and EBITDA margin contraction to 18.7%. The company maintained its FY27 EBITDA margin guidance of 18.5-20% and achieved key milestones with the US FDA approval for gAdvair Diskus and a strategic partnership for a Keytruda biosimilar. The US respiratory business showed strength with gProventil ranking No. 1 in the market, and South Africa's private market grew 1.3x faster than the market.

call_points.text: One India delivered 12% YoY growth, driven by branded prescription and chronic portfolio.
North America quarterly revenue reached $172 million, with expectations of reaching $1 billion exit run-rate.
Net cash equivalent balance stood at ₹9,823 crores as of 30th September.
U.S. FDA issued 7 observations in Form 483 for the Pithampur facility.
FY27 EBITDA margin guidance maintained at 18.5-20%.
gProventil ranked No. 1 in the US Albuterol MDI market with 22% share.
Material cost increased to ₹2,634 Cr in Q2FY27 from ₹2,498 Cr in Q2FY26.
Cash and Cash Equivalents stood at ₹10,522 Cr as of Sep-2026.
FY27 EBITDA margins are guided at 18.5% to 20% with second-half weighting due to new product launches.
North America aims for a $1 billion exit run rate by the end of FY27, backed by new respiratory approvals.
Total cash and cash equivalents stood at ₹11,140 Cr as of March 2026.

tax_litigation.as_last_disclosed: Disallowances of expenses u/s. 37(1) of the Income Tax Act from AY 2010-11 to AY 2022-23 (excluding AY 2011-12). Forums where matters are pending: Hon'ble High Court of Bombay, ITAT and CIT(A). Quantum of claim (Disputed tax value): INR 308 crores
tax_litigation.status: The Company has received an order for AY 2023-24 (FY 2022-23) from the Office of the Joint Commissioner of Income Tax in respect of one of matter pertaining to Section 37(1). The Company has preferred an appeal before Hon’ble CIT(A) against the alleged order. Pursuant to the said order, the aggregate quantum of claim (Disputed tax value) for disallowances of expenses u/s 37(1) from AY 2010-11 to AY 2023-24 (excluding AY 2011-12) stands at INR 366 crores. Accordingly, all the matters related to disallowances of expenses u/s. 37(1) of the Income Tax Act from AY 2010-11 to AY 2023-24 (excluding AY 2011-12) continue to remain pending for disposal at Hon'ble Bombay High Court / ITAT Mumbai & CIT(A).

operating_notes.text: Total U.S. albuterol market valued at approximately $1.5 billion according to IQVIA MAT February 2026.
Group operating segment reassessed to a single segment (Pharmaceutical and related products) following change in CODM.
One-India business crossed ₹12,500 Cr annual revenue milestone in FY26.
FY26 revenue reached a record ₹28,163 Cr with EBITDA of ₹5,925 Cr.
Sushrut Kulkarni appointed as President & Global Chief – Integrated Product Development (IPD) w.e.f. 18th May 2026.
Cipla targets a $1 billion run rate in the U.S. by the end of FY27.
One India grew 12% YoY with chronic mix at 60.4%; Yurpeak contributed ~₹80 Cr in Q1FY27.
North America revenue was $162 million; Albuterol MDI market share 21%; Ventolin generic launched with six-month exclusivity.
Field force stands at approximately 12,000 people; no significant manpower additions planned for FY27.
InvaGen Pharmaceuticals manufacturing facility in Hauppauge, Long Island, NY cleared routine USFDA cGMP inspection (19-22 Oct 2026) with zero Form 483 observations.
InvaGen Unit 3 facility inspection classified as VAI; Long Island facility inspected with zero 483 observations.

timeline.summary: Cipla received final USFDA approval for Albuterol Sulfate Inhalation Aerosol, the first AB-rated generic of Ventolin HFA, targeting the U.S. market.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹6,541.2 Cr (-2.8% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹554.64 Cr (-54.6% YoY).
Cipla reported Q4 FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹6,541 Cr and net profit of ₹555 Cr; with full-year FY26 revenue reaching a record ₹28,163 Cr.
Cipla released its investor presentation for Q4FY26 and FY26, reporting record annual revenue of ₹28,163 Cr.
Cipla announced board outcomes including the 90th AGM date for June 25, 2026, the appointment of Sushrut Kulkarni as Global Chief – IPD, cost auditor appointment, and stock option grants.
Cipla Limited shared the audio recording of its earnings conference call for Q4FY26 and FY26 on its website via **Rajendra Chopra RA**, signed digitally by **RAJEND** on May 13, 2026.
Cipla hosted its Q4FY26 earnings call, guiding for an FY27 EBITDA margin of 18.5-20% and a $1B U.S. exit run rate.

Cipla held its Q1FY27 earnings call on 23 July 2026, reporting revenue of ₹7,119 Cr (+2% YoY) and EBITDA margin of 16.7%, with management maintaining FY27 margin guidance of 18.5-20% and a US $1 billion exit run-rate target.
InvaGen Pharmaceuticals facility in Hauppauge, NY cleared a routine USFDA cGMP inspection with zero Form 483 observations.
Q2FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹7,403.93 Cr, net profit to shareholders ₹877.54 Cr.
Cipla reported Q2FY27 results with revenue of ₹7,404 Cr (-2% YoY) and EBITDA margin of 18.7%, while maintaining FY27 margin guidance and announcing US FDA approval for gAdvair Diskus.
Audio recording of earnings conference call for quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026 available on company website.
Cipla reported Q2FY27 consolidated revenue of ₹7,404 Cr and EBITDA margin of 18.7%, maintaining its full-year guidance.
